data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Implement various data visualizations using Chart.js to showcase Artemis capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage pipeline chart.
Cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics are displayed with appropriate charts.
Real-time dashboard includes line, bar, area, pie, and radar charts for different metrics.

features.title: Display Real Metrics
features.description: Present real metrics from recent Artemis runs in the demo.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are up-to-date and accurate.
Data is presented in a clear and understandable format.
Charts reflect actual performance data.

features.title: Integration and Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Showcase supervisor integration and code quality metrics using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Integration across stages is visualized with a pie chart.
Code quality metrics include TDD compliance and SOLID principles displayed in a radar chart.
Charts are interactive and informative.

features.title: HERO Section: What is Artemis?
features.description: Introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section clearly defines Artemis.
Content is engaging and informative.
Section is visually distinct from others.

features.title: Professional Design Elements
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across all slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Design aligns with the professional theme of the presentation.

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: Single HTML file contains all necessary CSS and JavaScript.
Chart.js library is correctly integrated.
File is named artemis_demo_chartjs.html and saved in /tmp/.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with the option for manual navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.
